items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: when it was Pete Hoyman's Club Plantation

ctx.x: Who were some of the clarinet players you remember as outstanding? We've already mentioned Aaron and now. Harry Shields.

Harry Shields. Bill Bourgeois. Of course, Raymond. Raymond Burke. And then, of course, to get back to piano players, another fine piano player just entered my mind. A little fella that used to play with Raymond at the Club Plantation. Oh, Julia Chavez. Mm-hmm. Julia Chavez was a good, very good, very good jazz piano player. Played very nice style. He played with Raymond quite a while at the, when it was Pete Hoyman's Club Plantation. Henry with Henry Walde. That was a real good little swinging little band. They…
